questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · isiNdebele Home Language Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Choose the sentence that shows correct concord for a formal isiNdebele Home Language essay.

options.text: Die leerders het sy boek vergeet.
Die leerders het hul boeke vergeet.
Die leerders het hulle boek vergeet.
Die leerder het hul boek vergeet.

questions.explanation: CAPS HL: concord between subject and possessive/agreement must be consistent (plural subject → plural possessive).

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · isiNdebele Home Language Paper 1 · Question 1.2

When writing a summary (isiNdebele Home Language Paper 1), which rule is MOST important?

options.text: Copy long phrases word-for-word from the passage
Add your personal opinion on the topic
Use your own words and stay within the word limit
Include every minor detail from the text

questions.explanation: NSC memos reward own-word summaries that capture main ideas within the stated length.

Which text type is appropriate for a formal bursary application (isiNdebele Home Language)?

options.text: Formal letter / email with clear subject line and polite register
Informal social-media post with slang
Cartoon strip with speech bubbles only
Unstructured list of random notes

questions.explanation: Transactional writing requires register, format, and purpose matched to the context.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · isiNdebele Home Language Paper 1 · Question 1.4

In a literature essay, what is the main purpose of discussing 'theme'?

options.text: To list every character's age
To explain the central message or idea the writer explores
To copy the poem without comment
To ignore the title of the work

questions.explanation: Theme analysis links evidence from the text to the writer's central message (CAPS literature outcome).
